description: Triple-negative breast cancer cell line HCC1395 and its matched EBV-immortalised B-lymphoblast normal HCC1395BL, published by the SEQC2 consortium as a reference tumour-normal pair with a high-confidence somatic truth set. Genomic truth-set validation case (layers L1/L2); never an immunogenicity validation.
pairing_provenance: Both lines derive from the same donor and are distributed as a matched pair by the SEQC2 Somatic Mutation Working Group; the truth VCFs were produced from their held-out sequencing datasets (v1.2.1 release).

somatic_snv_vcf.role: L1: high-confidence somatic SNV truth set (39447 records)

somatic_indel_vcf.role: L1: high-confidence somatic INDEL truth set

hc_regions_bed.role: L1: high-confidence regions used to re-verify v1.2.1 containment independently

expression_tpm_log2p1.role: L1: measured RNA expression, DepMap Public 23Q2 model ACH-000699 (HCC1395), verbatim row; values log2(TPM+1)

ensembl_entrez_map.role: crosswalk: Ensembl gene id -> Entrez (Ensembl BioMart, single documented query)

hla.note: Published HLA-I genotype carries HLA-A LOH: a single A allele (HLA-A*29:02). Hence 5 alleles across 3 loci, not 6.

expression.matrix: DepMap Public 23Q2 (figshare article 22765112), CC BY 4.0; matched normal HCC1395BL (ACH-002382) is absent from that RNA matrix
expression.interpretation: measured whole-cell-line gene TPM (cohort-free single-source quantity); the Tier-A gate treats TPM >= 1 as expression evidence
